WITH fee_order_user AS (
  SELECT 
    f.feerate,
    f.rebrate,
    o.recordvault,
    u.acctscope
  FROM fees f
  INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  INNER JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
),
order_net_rates AS (
  SELECT 
    recordvault,
    acctscope,
    AVG(feerate) - AVG(rebrate) as order_net_rate
  FROM fee_order_user
  GROUP BY recordvault, acctscope
),
scope_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    acctscope,
    AVG(order_net_rate) as scope_avg_net_rate,
    COUNT(*) as order_count
  FROM order_net_rates
  GROUP BY acctscope
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(scope_avg_net_rate) as overall_avg
  FROM scope_averages
)
SELECT 
  s.acctscope as scope,
  s.scope_avg_net_rate as avg_net_fee_rate,
  s.order_count as num_orders,
  s.scope_avg_net_rate - (SELECT overall_avg FROM overall_average) as difference_from_overall
FROM scope_averages s
